title: N-Way Concurrent Merge Conflict & Worktree Quarantine
description: 5 concurrent workers in isolated worktrees modify shared microservice files: 2 modify orthogonal files and merge cleanly, while 3 modify overlapping lines in auth.ts. Arbiter cleanly merges non-conflicting branches, detects 3-way collisions, aborts merges, isolates conflicting worktrees in CONFLICT, and maintains pristine main.
